about:
We are an English-speaking clan family based in the USA, with Clashers from all over the world. You can play in wars while you upgrade your base.

**Note:** Our CWL clans do not support accounts that need a Family Friendly clan. If your account needs one, find a different clan family.

**What we offer:**
🛡️ 1 tactical clan
🛡️ 2 Flexible Fun war clans
🛡️ 7 FWA clans for farmers
🛡️ CWL every month, for everyone

**Funnies** `#2Q9RLRCG`
**For:** players who want serious wars and 3-star attacks.
**Requirements:**
• TH13 or higher, with your previous Town Hall level fully maxed
• No heroes upgrading during war. Wars are always at full strength.
**What we expect:** Follow the war plan and work as a team. Not every attack will be perfect, but always try for 3 stars.

**Warriors United** `#2YRVY8YCP`
**Arcane Oasis** `#Y2J0ULYR`
**For:** lower-level players and players who want relaxed wars. Wars are 50v50, or the largest size possible.
**Requirements:** None. Heroes are not required.
**What we expect:**
• Use your first attack in every war. There is no performance target.
• Relaxed does not mean inactive. We play to win.
• If you do not war, you cannot stay in the clan.
**Tip:** Heroes upgrading in the tactical clan? Move to a Flexible Fun clan for war loot. Move back when your upgrades are done.

**Clash of Thrones** `#Q889GPL`
**CoT Wildlings** `#2YJVQUCYJ`
**Four and Twenty** `#8CV0GPPR`
**The Horde** `#2RRCJCI0`
**PlaneClashers** `#9UGQ0GL`
**Edrag Rush** `#2PPCL2GYP`
**Wonder Wall** `#C002YRYG`
**For:** farmers who want loot from back-to-back wars.
**How it works:** FWA (Farm War Alliance) sets the result of each war before it starts. A simple war plan tells you how to get that result. Heroes are not required.
**Requirements:**
• TH12 or higher
• War weight of 115 or higher
• All buildings built for your Town Hall level
These requirements are a guide. Leadership looks at each recruit and makes the final decision. Your interview gives more detail about each clan type.
Select **I understand - Continue** to confirm that you read about our clans and the Family Rules. Then read the WU Strike System.
strike:
A strike is a penalty for breaking a war rule or a clan rule. Each offense has a set number of strikes. The charts below list them.
Strikes for missed war attacks are recorded automatically after each war. Leadership adds all other strikes.
Strikes belong to each account. Moving to another family clan does not remove them.

### ✅ Remove your strikes
**Play 2 wars in a row** (use both attacks): 1 strike is removed.
**Play 6 wars in a row**: all your strikes are removed.
A strike also goes away by itself after **60 days**.
**Approved leave** pauses strikes. Ask a leader before you go.

Leadership takes action:
**1.** You have 12 hours to open a ticket and talk to us.
**2.** No ticket in 12 hours: we remove you from your clan. You cannot join another family clan for 1 week.
**3.** No reply in 1 week: your roles go back to new-member roles.
This chart shows the strikes for our main clans.
This chart shows the strikes for our FWA clans. An FWA mismatch war with a confirmed war plan gives no strike.

• Leadership can give a warning instead of strikes, except for red-row offenses. We record warnings.
• Leadership can remove a strike by majority vote.
• Leadership can change this system between seasons.
• A removed member can come back if all leaders vote yes.
Select **I understand - Continue** to confirm that you read and agree to the WU Strike System. Then read Family Particulars.
family: This page tells you what we expect from you every day, in war, and in CWL.
Each time you log in, post a Friendly Challenge. Do this at every Town Hall level. It gives everyone a chance to practice.

Get at least **1,000 points** in each Clan Games. Builder Base challenges help. If 40 members get 1,250 points each, the clan gets the 50,000 points it needs.
See your points on the [dashboard](https://dash.warriorsunited.cc), in Tasks → Clan Games.

**Tactical clan:** set your war status to **GREEN ✅** to join a war. Set it to **RED ❌** if you cannot play or your heroes are upgrading. If you do not, you get strikes. See the WU Strike System.
**FWA and Flexible Fun clans:** wars are 50v50. Keep your status **GREEN ✅**, also when you upgrade.
Fill the Clan Castle of the member below you with the troops they ask for. This is a team job. One person must not fill them all.

Your War General posts a war plan with your target. Do not attack your mirror before you see the plan. If the plan is late, ping your clan's War General role.
You have 24 hours to plan and attack. Attack for stars, not loot, unless your War General tells you different.

CWL is our main team event every month. You have 2 options:
• **Main CWL:** push for the best medals.
• **LazyCWL:** easy CWL with no pressure.

**Sign up on the [dashboard](https://dash.warriorsunited.cc/signup) before the deadline.** The dashboard shows the deadline. No sign-up, no play. There are no exceptions.
Leaders and War Generals build the rosters. They place you by war activity, war performance, and account strength. When the roster is published, you see your clan on the dashboard. Max 3 of your accounts go on one clan roster.

• Be ready to attack, and request your attack Clan Castle troops.
• Have your heroes ready.
• Donate max-level defense troops to the player below you, or to at least one teammate.
• Plan your attack. You have 24 hours for 1 attack.
Need help? Ask in <#1005916813378465832>, or look in <#1568000309177876480>.

Select **I understand - Continue** to confirm that you read the Family Particulars. Then go to Apply and open an application ticket.
There are 2 application ticket types. **Open only one.**
